name: mast-services-standdown
description: First operational step of a run: remove every MAST nssm service, so no part of the run can command telescope hardware and nothing is left that an accidental start could raise. A running mast-unit opens the mirror covers and homes the mount on process start (MAST_unit#132), with no interlock anywhere in the stack, and a unit arriving with the services registered from an earlier provisioning generation is one Start-Service away from that. Removal rather than a start mode because nothing starts these services in the first place: the unit is run by hand and raises PWI4, ps3cli and PHD2 itself, and PWShutter lost its consumer when the covers moved to PWI4's mirrorcover API. The four mast-* names go unconditionally; the pre-rename names (PWI4, PWShutter, PHD2) go only when nssm-hosted, which is what proves the registration is ours. Runs at order 20 -- after execution-policy (10) and bootstrap-reassert (15), before every module that installs anything. The driver removes them again before the build and transfer, which is the longer window; mast-services-finalize (9500) asserts the end state. See issue #159.
